name: gizza-ai/json-diff
summary: Structural diff of two JSON documents

tool.description: Compare two JSON documents and report their structural differences. Objects are compared key-by-key and arrays index-by-index, recursively. Returns a JSON report: { equal, added, removed, changed, changes:[{ path, kind: added|removed|changed, old?, new? }] } where each path is a JSON path like $.a.b or $.list[2]. Output indentation is configurable (indent=0 minifies). Runs locally.

right.description: The second (right/new) JSON document to compare against the first.

indent.description: Output indentation in spaces (1-8). Use 0 to minify. Default 2.
